page_title: KOL 0-2 LEV | FC Koln v Bayer Leverkusen 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+3' Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
85' The attendance is 50000.

84' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
82' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Linton Maina as he is replaced by Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln).
82' Here is a change. Eric Martel is going off and Timo Schultz gives the last tactical orders to Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln).
82' Faride Alidou comes off the pitch to be replaced by Steffen Tigges (1. FC Koln).
79' It's time for a substitution. Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Piero Hincapie.
78' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Stieler no option but to blow his whistle.
77' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Marvin Schwabe stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.

73' 0 - 2 Goal! Amine Adli produces a great pass that finds Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 0:2.
72' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
69' Problems for Timo Schultz as Justin Diehl is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Leart Paqarada (1. FC Koln) replaces him.
68' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a short corner kick.

67' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bayer Leverkusen.
66' Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) will replace Patrik Schick.
65' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Jonas Hofmann.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sargis Adamyan will be replaced by Justin Diehl (1. FC Koln).
63' Substitution. Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Granit Xhaka.
62' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
62' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. FC Koln win a corner.
61' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
60' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips in a cross from the corner, but Marvin Schwabe is well positioned and punches the ball away.
60' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayer Leverkusen are going to take it.
59' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
58' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.

57' A dangerous towering header by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
57' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.

56' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.

55' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike. If it hadn't been blocked by one of the defenders it could have ended up in the middle of the goal.

54' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

54' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Marvin Schwabe pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

52' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
52' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the free kick.
51' What an opportunity! Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) disappointed the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from inside the box against the right post!
50' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
49' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) crosses the ball into the box from a free kick, but Lukas Hradecky reads it well and gathers the ball.
48' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
47' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Xabi Alonso decided to make a change. Jeremie Frimpong is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.

45+4' Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
45+3' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bayer Leverkusen was in an offside position.
43' Max Finkgrafe (1. FC Koln) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick near the side line.
42' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

41' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop. Corner kick. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity.
41' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
38' 0 - 1 Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!

37' Marvin Schwabe was forced into action to thwart Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper.
35' Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
35' Chance! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
34' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
33' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Stieler has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
32' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
30' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Eric Martel (1. FC Koln), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!

27' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
26' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
25' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
23' Tobias Stieler shows the yellow card to Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) for a heavy challenge.
22' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
22' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
22' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tobias Stieler signals. Bayer Leverkusen are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
21' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
16' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
14' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln)! Let's see what he decides.
13' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' The game is interrupted as Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln) is flagged offside.

11' Linton Maina picks out Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) on the edge of the six-yard box, but the headed attempt bends just round the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
9' It looks like Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Stieler won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
6' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Patrik Schick, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
4' Patrik Schick picks out Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
3' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Tobias Stieler blows for a foul.
2' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half has just begun.
FC Koln will kick the game off.
Tobias Stieler is the one to supervise the game today.
